messages:
elena: Hey team — customer-jules reports a 403 when the app is embedded in an iframe. Not reproducible in a standalone tab. Console shows: "Refused to display 'https://api.redwood.ai' in a frame because it set 'X-Frame-Options'" and a network 403 with header `x-request-id: req_0a1b2c3d`. Can we get HAR + console logs and a curl that reproduces?

sam: Thanks Elena — yes. For iframe flows we need a slightly different capture. Quick checklist: preserve logs, enable "Save as HAR with content", capture cookies/localStorage snapshot, and include the exact user steps.

sam: Steps to capture (Chrome desktop) — short version:
1) Open the page with the embedded iframe.
2) Open DevTools (Cmd+Option+I / Ctrl+Shift+I).
3) In Network tab: check "Preserve log" and disable cache.
4) Reproduce the flow (click the embed button -> sign in -> trigger the failing request).
5) Right-click any request -> "Save all as HAR with content".
6) In Console tab, right-click -> "Save as..." to capture console output OR copy text.
7) Application tab -> Cookies and Local Storage: take a screenshot or export the token values.

devtools-bot: Detailed capture notes for iframe-specific issues:
- If the embed uses cross-origin requests, enable "Network > Allow CORS" not possible — instead collect request/response headers: we need `x-request-id`, `set-cookie`, `authorization` (if present) and `content-type`.
- If browser blocks third-party cookies, ask the customer to temporarily allow third-party cookies or disable tracking/privacy extensions. Record the browser + version and whether Chrome/Edge/Safari.

sam: Minimal repro steps we want in the ticket body (exact text from the user):
- Page URL with embed (full URL)
- Steps (1,2,3...) to trigger the request
- Time window when it happened (approx)
- Browser + version and OS
- Whether repro occurs in Incognito

sam: How to redact before upload: Remove any PII (emails, auth tokens). If you include request headers, redact `Authorization` and full cookie values — keep `x-request-id` unchanged. Example: `Authorization: [REDACTED]` but `x-request-id: req_0a1b2c3d` must remain.

devtools-bot: Example curl to reproduce if customer can run locally (replace token/cookies):
```bash
# basic GET reproduction with cookie+request id header
curl -v 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embed/validate' \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer [REDACTED]' \\n  -H 'Cookie: session=[REDACTED]; other=val' \\n  -H 'x-request-id: req_0a1b2c3d' \\n  --compressed
```
If the embed sends body JSON, paste that payload and use `-H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{...}'`.

elena: For Safari (customer-jules mentioned mobile Safari) add: Settings -> Safari -> Privacy & Security -> disable "Prevent Cross-Site Tracking" and re-test. Also ask them to test in desktop Safari with the Web Inspector attached (Develop -> Show Web Inspector).

support-bot: Upload path: attach the HAR + console + cookie screenshots to the Zendesk ticket and set tag `support:har-iframe`. If you can't attach, upload to our secure S3 share link: https://files.redwood.ai/upload and paste link in ticket.

customer-jules: I captured a HAR and console, saw `x-request-id: req_0a1b2c3d` on the failed request. I also attached a screenshot of the cookie panel. I get the same 403 in Incognito when third-party cookies are blocked.

sam: Perfect — thanks. Next steps for SRE/infra after we have the HAR: search logs for `req_0a1b2c3d`, check the auth service logs around that timestamp, and confirm whether the request was rejected due to missing cookie or CSRF check. If you have a full curl that reproduces, run it with `-v` and include response headers in the ticket.

devtools-bot: Quick troubleshooting tips while we wait:
- Try the embed page with cookies cleared and then sign in fresh, capture HAR.
- If the embed uses an iframe postMessage handshake, include the full postMessage payloads (Console copy).
- For transient 403s, note whether they follow a redirect chain (check the first 302 -> 200 -> 403 sequence in the Network tab).

elena: I'll attach what customer-jules uploaded to the Zendesk ticket and ping infra once you confirm receipt. Thanks all :thumbsup:
